preconditions.description: Length of S is between K and 10^5, inclusive.
All characters in S are lowercase alphabets.

postconditions.expression: return_value == sum(len(set(S[i:i+K])) == K-1 for i in range(len(S) - K + 1))
postconditions.description: The function returns the count of substrings of length K with exactly K-1 distinct characters.
